preconditions: FOR_EVERY Delta IN R EXISTS Gamma IN M WITH Gamma preccurlyeq Delta
cofinal_minimization.proof_reverse: M SUBSET R gives up_k(M,B) SUBSET up_k(R,B).
cofinal_minimization.proof_forward: For Theta in up_k(R,B), choose Delta in R with Delta preccurlyeq Theta; cofinality gives Gamma in M with Gamma preccurlyeq Delta; transitivity gives Gamma preccurlyeq Theta, hence Theta in up_k(M,B).

duplicate_deletion.conclusion: removing duplicate copies leaves up_k unchanged
duplicate_deletion.reason: up_k depends on existential membership in a set, not multiplicity

up_k_idempotence.proof_forward: A source Gamma in up_k(R,B) itself has a source Delta in R with Delta preccurlyeq Gamma; transitivity carries Delta to every target dominated by Gamma.
up_k_idempotence.proof_reverse: Every Theta in up_k(R,B) witnesses membership in up_k(up_k(R,B),B) using reflexivity Theta preccurlyeq Theta.

interpretation_ceiling.semantic_language_statement: If the cap-filtered source family R already denotes the complete semantic composition source family under O1-O5, then duplicate deletion, direct-predecessor minimization, and reapplication of up_k neither remove nor invent any represented full-set state.
interpretation_ceiling.forbidden_overclaim: The minimizer does not by itself prove that a source trajectory is realizable or that upstream expand/join/shrink caller premises hold.
interpretation_ceiling.source_family_requirement: R must already be semantically complete and cap-filtered by the admitted O1-O5 chain.

published_source.compactification_equivalence: Corollary 3.8: tau(Gamma) is preorder-equivalent to Gamma.
published_source.full_set_definition: FS_k(V,B) is the compact width<=k upward language of realizable B-trajectories under preccurlyeq.
published_source.lattice_characterization: Lemma 3.5 characterizes preccurlyeq by monotone H/V/diagonal synchronized lattice paths.
published_source.up_k_definition: up_k(R,B) contains compact width<=k targets Gamma for which some Delta in R satisfies Delta preccurlyeq Gamma.
